soundness_flags.label: ass:bounded-outcomes / def:response-class
soundness_flags.one_line: Boundedness is imposed three times: by the type of Y, by the [0,1]-valued response-class construction, and again as a load-bearing assumption.

soundness_flags.label: thm:certificate-sound-complete
soundness_flags.one_line: The certificate grammar requires its incumbent to carry Dstar=Wbar(Sstar), while Dstar is already defined as the global minimum; this makes soundness a definitional restatement rather than a branch-tree certificate theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace Dstar in the certificate grammar by a claimed incumbent value vstar=Wbar(Sstar); make Check recompute vstar and verify that each optimistic descendant has width at least vstar, then prove global optimality from exhaustive branch coverage.

Make the allocation domain explicit: require nonempty S and sum over c in S of n_c=N wherever randomization and design bands are invoked, while retaining the empty-panel report as a separate deterministic case.

Elevate the field kernel by proving an approximation ratio or a nontrivial polynomial certificate-size theorem on a named structural class of action-score cost tensors, with a concrete worked instance and verifier output.

recommended_next_step: Revise the certificate definition to remove the circular use of Dstar, remove the redundant boundedness assumption, and then advance the repaired field-tier width-and-certified-design kernel to Stage 0.
